idea: A booking app for mobile dog groomers so they stop losing jobs to missed calls

turns.text: Solo mobile groomers. They are elbow deep in a wet dog when the phone rings, so they miss it and the customer books someone else. About $90 a time.
Mostly the money, but also calling back at 7pm to find the slot has gone. It makes them feel unprofessional. Draft the challenge.
Dog owners who book by phone
I spoke to two groomers last week. One said she ignores the phone completely while working and loses maybe three jobs a week. The other has her partner answer.
That's all the research I have for now. Yes, let's move on.
